title: Envelope
description: Wire message for FuseItAll 0.2.0+ (protocol_v 1). Decoders ignore unknown fields. Encoders must always emit protocol_v, type, sender and capabilities. sender.app_version is display-only and optional for backward compatibility.

protocol_v.description: Wire protocol version. Higher than the receiver speaks -> error/UPDATE_REQUIRED.

type.description: Message type: ping, pong, error, notif-post, notif-dismiss, notif-apps-req, notif-apps-resp, clip-push, settings-sync, playback-state, or playback-cmd.

platform.description: Sending device class, e.g. mac or android.

min_peer_build.description: Oldest peer build this sender still talks to.

app_version.description: Human app version, e.g. 0.1.0. Display-only; older peers omit it.

payload.description: Type-specific body; shape defined per message schema.
